name: 3D Semantic Segmentation Post-processing (3D-OVS)
definition: A post-processing pipeline that selects the best semantic-level binary mask by thresholding, binarizing, and evaluating average relevancy within masks.
summary: 3D-OVS resolves semantic ambiguity in 3D Gaussian Splatting by thresholding multiple relevancy maps and selecting the binary mask with the highest average relevancy score.
